query:
SELECT
            ba.id,
            ba.asset_id,
            ba.transaction_id,
            jsonb_build_object('id', ba.account_id, 'full_name', COALESCE(ap.full_name, ag.label), 'type', (CASE WHEN ap.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'person' ELSE 'group' END)) AS "account: AccountEmbed",
            lower(ba.during) as begins,
            coalesce(upper(ba.during), '+infinity'::timestamp) as "ends!: PgDateTime",
            ba.activated,
            ba.maintenance
        FROM
            bookable_appointments ba LEFT JOIN accounts_people ap ON ba.account_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN account_groups ag ON ba.account_id = ag.id WHERE true    ORDER BY during LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2
